detail: Full summary: plain `git status` rewrites .git/index and takes index.lock (a concurrent `git add` fails rc=128 'index.lock: File exists'); `git --no-optional-locks status` is accurate and never writes; `git diff-index --quiet HEAD` reports 5,137 false 'M' after an mtime-only touch; `git push` changes ahead/behind while HEAD and FETCH_HEAD stay unchanged (V3 + critics EXECUTED)
